bet.text: Have a very good shooter first: a rotating turret developed from the team's 2020 robot.

demand.text: Shooting was the main design goal. Climbing is weighed against it: with two quick, sure traversal partners, the team stays out and shoots.

cycle.text: The intake centers cargo into the elevator, the turret aims by Limelight, and a wrong-color ball is missed on purpose.
The operator points out cargo the driver cannot see.

endgame.text: Two kinds of hooks work rung by rung to traversal; the fastest time given is about 10 to 15 seconds.
It usually starts around the endgame, sometimes after one more scoring cycle.

fallback.text: A low rung hang in about two to three seconds, added by the championship, for when a partner may fall or the ranking point looks lost.
A recap of the Turing semifinals describes it and 2468 rotating on defense.

changed.text: Building started late: in-person activities were cancelled for four weeks of the build season.
The intake was destroyed at the Waterloo event and rebuilt stronger, with two fewer mecanum wheels on one side.
After the first event a beam break and LED signal were added for balls behind the hub and in the far hangar.

outcome.text: 47-12-0 in official play; ranked 26 by championship OPR (54.07, Turing).

facts.text: A forum poster lists the robot among the big names without pneumatics

solves.text: Cargo leaving the hub jumps around and takes a long time to settle

cost.text: The first version was destroyed at the Waterloo event

facts.text: Mecanum wheels spinning opposite ways center a ball and send it up the conveyor

facts.text: A lower beam break flashes the LEDs white when a ball passes
A color sensor near the top compares two color values of the ball
The turret turns a little to miss an opposite-color ball on purpose
The second ball is delayed so the sensor reads it properly

cost.text: A forum poster later argued a turret may not have been the ideal choice for most teams in 2022

The hood goes up past an upper distance limit and down past a lower one

solves.text: Reach the traversal rung, or hang low fast

facts.text: Ratchet hooks take the mid rung; telescopic arms extend, pivot and take the next rung, and the cycle repeats
Fastest traversal time given, about 10 to 15 seconds
